description:
Initial ZenSMS patch bundle for ZenSMS 1.2.04.

Included patches:
- enable premium state — makes synchronous and reactive premium checks report true; enabled by default.
- RTL SMS lists — adds independent settings for RTL conversation rows and RTL message content/metadata; disabled by default.

Both patches are contained in the single patches-1.0.0.mpp download and can be selected independently in Morphe.
